id='content'><section class="g-py-50"><div class="container"><div class="row"><div class="col-lg-9"><div class='g-mt-30 g-mt-0--lg main-image g-brd-around g-brd-gray-light-v4 g-pa-2 g-mb-25'><img class='img-fluid' alt='' src='/site/assets/files/29794/aswc_garda_111-min_1.1140x450.jpg'></div><div class="u-heading-v2-1--bottom g-mt-30 g-mt-0--lg g-mb-30"><h1 class="u-heading-v2__title g-mb-10">Private Beach for Sport and Relaxation</h1></div><p>Looking for a <strong>hotel directly on Lake Garda</strong> with a <strong>private beach</strong>, perfect for <strong>sailing</strong>, <strong>kitesurfing</strong>, <strong>wingfoiling</strong>, <strong>catamaran</strong>, <strong>kayaking</strong> or <strong>stand-up paddleboarding (SUP)</strong>? Univela in Campione del Garda is the ideal destination for active travelers seeking a peaceful and sporty holiday surrounded by nature.<h2>A Unique Place: Quiet, Exclusive, Easily Accessible</h2><p><strong>Campione del Garda</strong> is the only village on the lake <strong>not located along the main Gardesana road</strong>. Access is through a tunnel, keeping the area free of traffic and noise. You can <strong>park safely in Univela’s private parking</strong> and enjoy stunning views of the lake and the surrounding mountains in total tranquility.<h2>Watersports at Your Doorstep</h2><h3>Sailing and Catamaran</h3><p>Each morning, the northern wind creates perfect waves for <strong>sailing and catamaran sessions</strong>. Univela offers rentals and courses with certified instructors.<h3>Kitesurfing and Wingfoiling</h3><p><strong>Kitesurfers and wingfoilers</strong> love Campione’s wind conditions, dedicated launch area, and well-equipped gear wash and drying zone.<h3>Kayaking and SUP</h3><p>Start your day peacefully with a <strong>kayak or SUP</strong> session while enjoying the magical sunrise over Monte Baldo and the calm morning waters of the lake.<h2>Hiking with Scenic Views</h2><h3>The “Anello del Cotone” Trail</h3><p>This <strong>loop hike</strong> connects Campione to Tremosine via the old Gardesana path and the famous <strong>Strada della Forra</strong>—one of the most scenic roads in Europe with tunnels, waterfalls, and canyon views.<h3>The Power Station Trail</h3><p>For a steeper challenge, take the historic path used to maintain the hydroelectric pipes. In about 30 minutes, you’ll reach a beautiful mountain trail with small lakes, waterfalls, and views of the San Michele gorge.<h2>Food and Relaxation by the Lake</h2><h3>Lunch at Terraferma Restaurant</h3><p>From 11:30 a.m., enjoy lunch at the <strong>lakefront restaurant</strong>, offering both <strong>healthy, sport-friendly meals</strong> and more gourmet regional dishes prepared by the chef.<h3>Romantic Sunset Aperitif</h3><p>Book a <strong>deck chair or lakeside table</strong> and sip an aperitif as the sun sets behind the mountains, casting golden light on Malcesine and the eastern coast. A perfect end to an active day.<h2>Tailored Services for Active Guests</h2><ul><li>Air-conditioned rooms and apartments<li>High-speed Wi-Fi throughout the property<li>Drying room and secure gear storage<li>Direct access to the private beach<li>Watersports courses and equipment rental</ul><h2>Book Your Active Holiday at Lake Garda</h2><p><strong>Univela Campione del Garda</strong> is more than just a hotel: it’s a <strong>home base for nature and sport lovers</strong>, offering comfort, peace, and unforgettable outdoor experiences. <strong>Book now</strong> and discover Lake Garda like never before!<h2 class='g-mt-30'>Gallery</h2><div class='children gallery row g-mt-25'><div class='col-md-4 col-sm-6 g-mb-30'><a class='js-fancybox d-block u-block-hover u-bg-overlay
